mapper.select: SELECT (case when length( ifnull( b.device_name, '' )) = 0 then a.device_name else b.device_name end) devname FROM vm_device_info_t a left join vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t b on a.device_code = b.device_code WHERE b.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND b.delete_flag = '0' AND a.delete_flag = '0'
